### Offline Deterministic Verification Commands

```bash
# 1. Verify read-only source SHA-256 manifest without mutating customer originals
python3 .github/skills/apex-rfi-rfp/scripts/extract_pursuit_sources.py \
  --source-dir "agent-output/{pursuit_slug}/source" \
  --verify-manifest "agent-output/{pursuit_slug}/pricing/source-manifest.json"

# 2. Audit SKU retirements, regional GA status, and retail meter evidence (excluding DevTestConsumption)
python3 .github/skills/apex-rfi-rfp/scripts/audit_pursuit_skus_and_rates.py \
  --validate-bundle "agent-output/{pursuit_slug}/contracts/pursuit-cost-estimate.json" \
  --deprecations-file .github/data/azure-deprecations.json

# 3. Validate workbook formula AST grammar, typed <v> cached values, and <=255-char header/footer bounds
python3 .github/skills/apex-rfi-rfp/scripts/xlsx_ast_cache.py \
  --workbook "agent-output/{pursuit_slug}/commercials/{pursuit_slug}.boq.xlsx" \
  --verify

# 4. Run end-to-end offline package integrity, link containment, and regression checks
python3 .github/skills/apex-rfi-rfp/scripts/verify_pursuit_package.py \
  --package-dir "agent-output/{pursuit_slug}"

# 5. Build external partner archive only after documented Purview clearance is recorded
python3 .github/skills/apex-rfi-rfp/scripts/package_pursuit.py \
  --package-dir "agent-output/{pursuit_slug}" \
  --exclude-restricted-originals \
  --acknowledge-purview-clearance "{approver_upn_or_ticket_id}"
```
